aurora-magenta.$description: Aurora Magenta — Headline gradient start, icon fills, decorative brand strokes — the single chromatic voice of the system, used as gradient text on display headings and as fill on small icon badges

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Muted violet used for decorative SVG strokes and secondary graphic outlines — sits behind the magenta as the system-wide line color

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary body and heading text on light surfaces — slightly warmer than pure black, reads softer at large sizes while keeping AAA contrast

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Highest-weight text and the densest border color — used where maximum contrast is required against the near-white canvas

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Page canvas and subtle surface tint — the entire site reads on this near-white, giving the aurora gradient something warm to land on

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card and elevated surface fill — floats above Lavender Mist as the base for product cards, phone screen, and feature panels

frost-shadow.$description: Frost Shadow — Shadow tone used in the multi-layer card elevation — too light to be a border, present only as the ambient outer blur

pebble.$description: Pebble — Mid-neutral for muted body text and link borders — the default text color for descriptions and the border for inline link affordances

silver-lining.$description: Silver Lining — Light hairline border and secondary muted text — used on card edges and quiet metadata rows

cloud-veil.$description: Cloud Veil — Softest neutral for decorative SVG fills and ambient accents — supports the aurora without competing with the magenta

tidewater-navy.$description: Tidewater Navy — Violet accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

aurora-green.$description: Aurora Green — Gradient stop in the page-level aurora and accent on positive chart lines inside the phone mockup

averta-standard.$description: Sole typeface across the system. Custom geometric sans with humanist warmth — the slightly rounded terminals soften what would otherwise be a cold fintech voice.
